draft.shortGloss: to travel; to go on a trip
draft.emotion: excited and anticipating, like someone packing their bags for a new adventure
notes: Use 여행하다 for the action of traveling, often with a destination marked by 을/를 (e.g., 유럽을 여행하다). In everyday speech, people also frequently say 여행(을) 가다 (to go on a trip) or 여행(을) 다녀오다 (to go on a trip and come back).
